item.title: On Leadership
item.description:
The original interview was published on VC.


— Konstantin, why do you think being a leader is worthwhile or interesting?

— Let’s start with what leadership actually is. There are many different definitions — Peter Drucker, for instance, wrote: «Leadership is the ability to help a person move beyond their own limitations.»

Leadership is the skill of positively influencing people in a way that enables a group to achieve ambitious goals through the contribution of each individual member.

item.title: How to Run a Retrospective for a Large Team
item.description:
A retrospective is a group reflection exercise — a tool for continuous improvement and cultural change within a team.

Most of us hear about «retros» in the context of end-of-sprint ceremonies in iterative development. However, the vast majority of teams don’t follow Scrum or any iterative approach to building software products. That’s no reason to abandon self-reflection or group reflection when you hit key project milestones.

Below is a detailed 8-step plan with timings for running an engaging retrospective with a large team (10+ people).
